description: Works out the Child Care Subsidy (CCS) for each child and the gap fee the family pays, as the paycalculator.com.au childcare calculator does, with the 2026-27 income thresholds and hourly rate caps. Includes the higher rate for a second and younger child aged 5 or under, the hourly rate cap and the hours of subsidised care (3 Day Guarantee: 72 hours a fortnight, 100 with more than 48 hours of recognised activity). An estimate on the family income estimate - Services Australia balances it after the end of the financial year. CCS only, not Additional Child Care Subsidy.

activityHoursPerFortnight.description: Recognised activity of the parent with the lower hours (work, study, training, volunteering, looking for work), hours a fortnight. More than 48 gives 100 hours of subsidised care, otherwise 72. Assumed more than 48 when not given.

careType.description: centre: long day care or occasional care; familyDayCare; outsideSchoolHours: before, after school and vacation care; inHome: In Home Care.

sessionHours.description: Hours charged for each day - the session length, not the hours attended. Defaults to 10; ask or check for outside school hours care, as sessions are much shorter.

familyIncome.description: Combined family adjusted taxable income for the year (the person and their partner). Use details.adjustedTaxableIncome from calculate_pay, plus the partner's, when available.

firstNationsChildOrExemption.description: An Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander child, or an exemption (e.g. a grandparent carer) - 100 hours of subsidised care.

withholding.description: % of the subsidy withheld each fortnight. Defaults to 5%, as Services Australia does.

name: child_care_subsidy

higherRate.description: Whether the higher rate for a second or younger child applies.

hourlyRateCap.description: The cap for the care type and age - the subsidy is worked out on the lower of the fee and the cap.

gap.description: What the family pays: fee less the subsidy paid.

subsidy.description: Subsidy paid to the service, after withholding.

withheld.description: Subsidy withheld - paid back at the end-of-year balance if entitled.

notes.description: Fees above the cap, hours over the subsidised hours, the higher rate limit and the withholding - pass these on.

subsidisedHoursPerFortnight.description: Hours of subsidised care per child each fortnight.
